summary: A 1932 L-4 cab on a log crib, a 1942 telephone line, and a tower the sources date differently; one source reports its 1976 destruction.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a log crib base, later a 30-foot L-4 tower
facts.status_note: One source says the tower was destroyed in 1976. No source describes what remains on the summit.

access.note: A listed trail runs from Reservoir Lake Campground to Selway Mountain.

visit.trail_note: 2.0-mile trail from Reservoir Lake Campground to Selway Mountain

events.note: L-4 cab on a log crib base
firelookout.com says a 30-foot L-4 tower replaced the cab; the 1942 Dillon papers describe a tower still being erected, so the date is disputed
Telephone line run up Bloody Dick Creek to the lookout, reported completed in late June 1942
Tower destroyed according to firelookout.com; no second source found

notes_for_editor: Tower date and height conflict. firelookout.com gives a 30-foot tower built in 1941, but Dillon papers of May-June 1942 describe a tower not yet finished (30 feet on May 25, 39 feet on May 27). The 1976 destruction date comes only from firelookout.com; two web searches found nothing else. A 1956 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description places a survey mark beneath the tower; no current status found. Access rests on a trail listing, not a Forest Service source. Record location and height (9.1 m = 30 ft) match firelookout.com's tower height, not the 39-foot figure. No corrections proposed.
